title: Marc Guillaume, Île-de-France Prefect, Appointed Head of Conseil d'État
detail: Marc Guillaume, the prefect of Île-de-France, was appointed to lead the Conseil d'État, France's highest administrative court and supreme body for administrative law. The appointment marks a significant transition in French state administration, with Guillaume moving from one of the country's most prominent prefectural posts to the apex of the administrative judiciary.
